reviews.text: I loved them, they look very natural, nothing exaggerated. I was very happy with your work, thank you.

about_erlym.title: Meet Erlym Monasterios
about_erlym.subtitle: Founder and technician behind Mia's Aesthetics. Your beauty in expert hands.
about_erlym.p1: Erlym is the heart of Mia's Aesthetics. With 20+ years of experience between Costa Rica and the United States, she specializes in lashes, advanced facials and premium aesthetic procedures.
about_erlym.p2: Her philosophy is simple: every client is unique and every treatment is tailored. Before doing anything, she listens, evaluates and proposes — always aiming for the most natural and lasting result.
about_erlym.p3: Ongoing training in Morpheus 8, Thermage, hair-by-hair lash technique, BB Glow and facial fillers with premium brands.
